info.scriptSrcText: property this, Xpos, Ypos, claw, guyState, Yvel, grav, mapXPos, mapXTile, Xvel, loopX, loopWidth, jump, jumpVel, blackCopterglobal gPaused, gXVel, gXOffset, gTileIDList, gTileHeightList, gRescueCounton beginSprite  this = sprite(the currentSpriteNum)  claw = sprite(80)  blackCopter = sprite(79)  Xpos = this.locH  Ypos = this.locV  Xvel = 0  Yvel = 0  guyState = #claw  grav = 1  loopX = gTileIDList.count * 128 * 0.5  loopWidth = gTileIDList.count * 128  mapXPos = (gTileIDList.count / 2 * 128) + Xpos - 256 - 64  mapXTile = mapXTile = integer(mapXPos / 128)  jump = 0  puppetSound(4, member(82, "Sfx"))endon exitFrame  if gPaused = 0 then    case guyState of      #claw:        Xpos = claw.locH        Ypos = claw.locV        this.locH = Xpos        this.locV = Ypos        doGroundHeight()      #ONGROUND:        Xpos = Xpos + gXVel + gXOffset        this.locH = Xpos        this.locV = Ypos - jump        jumpVel = jumpVel - grav        jump = jump + jumpVel        if jump < 0 then          jumpVel = 10        end if    end case  end ifendon doGroundHeight  mapXPos = mapXPos - gXVel  if mapXPos > loopWidth then    mapXPos = mapXPos - loopWidth  end if  if mapXPos < 0 then    mapXPos = mapXPos + loopWidth  end if  temp = (mapXPos - 0.5) mod 128  temp1 = mapXPos - temp  temp2 = integer(temp1 / 128)  mapXTile = temp2 + 1  localXPercent = (mapXPos - ((mapXTile - 1) * 128)) / 128  tempID = gTileIDList[mapXTile]  groundHeightLeft = gTileHeightList[mapXTile]  temp = mapXTile + 1  if temp > gTileIDList.count then    temp = temp - gTileIDList.count  end if  groundHeightRight = gTileHeightList[temp]  groundDiff = groundHeightRight - groundHeightLeft  diff = Ypos + 10 - (280 - groundHeightLeft) + (groundDiff * localXPercent)  if (diff > 0) and (blackCopter.firedCount >= 10) then    Ypos = Ypos - diff    this.locV = Ypos    guyState = #ONGROUND    gRescueCount = 1    puppetSound(4, member(85, "Sfx"))  end ifend
